scope: Focused bounded scheduler code and regression checks; fixed-panel efficacy not yet tested.

review.scope: Scheduling source/test/docs delta and v10 versus v9 harness only; no catalog/model/probe execution, no broad pipeline re-audit.

resolved_findings.issue: Fallback guide execution incremented absent slot fallback_attempted counter, causing reachable KeyError for inner implicit fallback.
resolved_findings.resolution: Initialized slot counter; scheduler regression includes implicit fallback work items and verifies they are attempted.

resolved_findings.issue: Preparation limit indication was suppressed after partial nonempty preparation.
resolved_findings.resolution: Report preparation_limit_observed independently of work count; partial-preparation deadline regression added. Sticky global limit observation explicitly does not assert missing work.

reviewed_invariants: Selected inner-rule policy and original512 rule inspections remain unchanged; preparation retains original slot/rule/guide enumeration and calls existing cached reverse once per scheduled rule/target request without chemistry retries.
Stable typed-first sorting occurs across all prepared guides within each outer plan; ties preserve prior slot/rule/guide order, including approximate/fallback reachability.
Execution advances one prepared guide per outer plan per sweep; inner compatibility filter, rank/beam, outer stage and route admission remain unchanged.
Existing stage functions enforce catalog, fingerprint, combination, generated-product and replay/audit gates. No cap increase or new catalog lookup mechanism.
Deadline checked during preparation, at sweep and workitem boundaries and in existing stage paths. Prepared-but-unattempted items are counted as deferred; unenumerated future work is not counted.
Bounded plan trace separates preparation rule/normalization cost from actual catalog-row execution, records fallback attempts and exhausted-catalog attempts.
v10-v9 harness delta changes diagnostic_version/scope only; exact pre-evidence gates and complete eligible/rejected graph retention unchanged.

independent_checks.result: 55 passed in13.15s on final source/test hashes; includes genuine one/two-step audited replay, scheduler starvation-order fixture, fallback attempts and preparation/execution expiry controls.
Runtime/tests unchanged between focused test run and receipt; docs and unexecuted v10 harness bound here.

author_reported_checks.format: Ruff check and format check all passed
author_reported_checks.harness: v10 import-only preflight passed; no catalog or model run

limitations: This is guide-level ordering, not a guarantee of balanced catalog work: one guide can consume substantial shared budget.

Eager bounded preparation can still consume rule-inspection and reverse-normalization budgets before execution; preparation_limit_observed can inherit a prior global limit even when current plan uses cache hits.
